{{Quote|If you run from a pack of akk dogs, they will chase you until you're dinner. But if you stand firm and look the lead dog in the eye, they will ignore you out of respect.|[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Drake Lo'gaan/Legends|Drake Lo'gaan]]|<ref name="Evasive Action: Prey">''[[Evasive Action: Prey]]''</ref>}}
'''Akk dogs''', sometimes called '''aak dogs''', were large [[Reptomammal/Legends|reptomammals]] native to [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]].

==Anatomy and biology==
{{Quote|The one I struck has barely slowed down! Lightsabers have little effect on those thick hides!|[[Depa Billaba/Legends|Depa Billaba]]|<ref name="Emissaries">''[[Star Wars: Emissaries to Malastare]]''</ref>}}
[[File:AkkDog-TJP.png|thumb|left|300px|An akk dog profile]]
Scaled reptomammals native to [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]], akk dogs were [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and thus capable of being domesticated by the native [[Korun/Legends|Korunnai]]. Great companions to these nomadic people, maturing from pups to Hounds in two to four months, akks were used for protection&mdash;not only of the tribe, but of the great [[grasser]] herds shepherded through the jungles by Korun herders.<ref name="Shatterpoint" />

Akk dogs had triangular teeth in jaws strong enough to crush [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]]; large [[Color/Legends|black]] tongues; scaly hides that could block a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]; armored, muscular tails the length of their body; shovel-sized splayed claws; and armored, lidless eyes. Their bodies were as long as [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]]. Their heads had six vestigial horns arranged in a triangular pattern, and they had olfactory pits next to their nose. Akk dogs had two smaller varieties, and were also related to [[Akk wolf|akk wolves]].<ref name="Shatterpoint" />

==Akk dogs and Galactic history==
{{Quote|I can't fit what I know of Haruun Kal into a guidebook description. Too much of what I know is the color of the sunflash and the smell of the wind off Grandfather's Shoulder, the silken ripple of a grasser's undercoat through my fingers, the hot fierce sting of an akk dog's Force-touch. |Private Journals of Mace Windu|<ref name="Shatterpoint" />}}
[[File:AkkAttacksGallia-SWREP16.jpg|thumb|right|200px|An akk dog attacks [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] in 32 BBY]]
Following the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], akks were often seen as companion to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]], forming a [[The Force/Legends|Force]] bond like that seen between the Korunnai on the akks' homeworld. Akk dogs were studied by the esteemed [[Jedi Researcher|biologist]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bowspritz]] during his visit to the [[Exploration Corps/Legends|Exploration Corps]] compound on [[Ord Canfre/Legends|Ord Canfre]].<ref name="The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force real-life book">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>

Illegal trade of akks reached new heights around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], as [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] sent the hounds off to various worlds, most notably the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] homeworld of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. While on Malastare dealing with the unrelated matter of the [[Red Iaro/Legends|Red Iaro]] terrorist group, several members of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] were attacked by several akk dogs. Due to his Korun heritage, Master [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] was able to calm the hounds, but became deeply troubled by their use as attackers. Taking it upon himself to investigate the increased smuggling of these creatures, Windu traveled to Nar Shaddaa in hopes of shutting down the black market there. Meeting with fellow Jedi [[Depa Billaba/Legends|Depa Billaba]] and [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], Windu commandeered a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] to reach the [[Circus Horrificus/Legends|Circus Horrificus]] complex, where [[mutant akk dog]]s were being used. Along with his brother and sister Jedi, Windu confronted [[Gargonn]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], the leader of the smuggling ring, and shut down his operation.<ref name="Emissaries" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Windu encountered akks once more when he returned to his home planet of Haruun Kal to find Depa Billaba, who had fallen into madness there.<ref name="Shatterpoint" />

==Cultural influences==
Inspired by the ferociousness of akk dogs, the [[Skaak Tippers]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer gang]] incorporated the word "aak" into the name of their gang so as to give the impression that they were a pack of ferocious computer hackers.<ref name="CorSec Database H-Z">{{SonyCite|url=players/guides.vm?id=80113|text=CorSec Database H-Z|int=CorSec Database H-Z}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The Death Star is not a good place to have Aak Dogs, people!|A [[bitizen]] through the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Tiny Death Star">''[[Star Wars: Tiny Death Star]]''</ref>}}
While "akk dog" is used in the majority of [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] sources, they were called "aak dogs" in the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' game and related material.<ref name="CorSec Database H-Z" />
